data.one_liner: A Flutter wrapper widget to add horizontal swipe callbacks for chat views.
data.what_it_does: SwipeTo is a widget wrapper that detects horizontal left and right swipes on its child component. It animates the child widget and triggers callbacks upon completing the swipe, displaying icons or custom widgets beneath the child during the gesture.
use_when: You are building a chat application and need message reply actions on swipe.
You want to add horizontal swipe-to-action behaviors to list items.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-stage swipe actions like native email list tile dismissals with multiple revealed buttons.
strengths: Supports both left and right directional swipes simultaneously.
Customizable icons, custom background widgets, sensitivity, and animation duration.
weaknesses: Requires manual UniqueKey configuration when used inside a ListView to avoid state bugs.
